title: AI Stocks Rebound as Kioxia Jumps 14% on Nvidia Memory Demo
summary: AI stocks rebounded Thursday as Kioxia rose as much as 14.5% after a GPU memory demo with Nvidia, and Nasdaq 100 futures gained 1.1% in Asian trade.
body_markdown:
## What Did Nvidia (NVDA) and Kioxia Demonstrate?


According to[Kioxia's announcement on Business Wire](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/kioxia-nvidia-collaborate-expand-effective-041900475.html) , Kioxia SSDs paired with Nvidia's SCADA software, short for Scaled Accelerated Data Access, showed the potential to extend effective GPU memory capacity to petabyte scale. The aim is to make large AI datasets usable beyond the capacity limits of high bandwidth memory (HBM) alone.


The proof of concept used an Nvidia GB200 NVL72 rack-scale system with 18 server nodes and 144 Kioxia XD8 Series 7.68 TB SSDs, providing approximately 1.1 PB of raw capacity, and Kioxia said the setup has the potential to process a database of 2 trillion vectors. The release frames the result as potential, and Kioxia said it remains engaged with Nvidia in evaluating the technical feasibility and performance of the architecture.


The announcement came as Nvidia faced governance questions. According to[Investing.com](https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/asian-stocks-rally-as-taiwan-south-korea-rebound-nvidia-risks-linger-5005239) , AI shares fell for a second session on Wednesday after Monday's relief rally sparked by Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, and S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia's AA credit rating on CreditWatch Negative, citing concerns over board independence and management oversight.


## Why Did Micron (MU) Fall on Wednesday?


[Micron Technology (MU)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) fell after TrendForce published research showing that Chinese cloud service providers have reduced memory orders planned for 2027, according to[JKN](https://news.jkn.co.kr/editions/english/post/1123324) . The shares touched an intraday low of $548.13 during[Micron's Wednesday decline](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/micron-mu-stock-news-november-26-2026/) before paring part of the loss by the close, per the same report.


TrendForce said the order cuts, combined with rising output, threaten to push the NAND flash memory market into oversupply and trigger a downward pricing cycle. JKN reported that DRAM, roughly three-quarters of Micron's sales, is projected to remain undersupplied through 2027 as American buyers absorb available capacity.


## ASML (ASML) Gains 2.4% as European Chip Stocks Rise


European chipmakers joined the rebound. According to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/26/stock-markets-today-.html) ,[ASML Holding (ASML)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/asml/) gained 2.4% in early European trading on Thursday, while ASMI rose 2.8% and Infineon traded more than 4% higher.


The Stoxx 600 Technology index jumped almost 2%, CNBC reported, though it has lost more than 12% so far this month amid jitters around a potential AI bubble and the ousting and return of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO.
